summary: Shot has a fast arm whip, a mid-air hand from off-screen, and unlit blue confetti cubes crossing the dancer's torso, plus a stiff mirrored stance.

faults.what: Cut-in frames 124.83-124.96: torso and arms change quickly, with the left arm swinging up and back over 3-4 frames. Reads as the cut tweening, not a settled first pose.
faults.fix: Start the clip on the settled pose, or trim the first 5 frames so the shot opens on a clear pose.

faults.what: Arm whips from low at 124.96 to a high horizontal swing at 125.03, then up over the head at 125.06-125.09. Few in-between frames, so it reads as a snap.
faults.fix: Add in-between frames or ease the arm swing, with a short anticipation before it.

faults.what: Large bare arms and hands enter from the right and top edge (125.66-125.83) and cross the frame beside the dancer. This is the 'three of him' idea read as stray limbs. It matches the frame-difference spike and is distracting.
faults.fix: Keep the other dancers' limbs out of frame or show them fully, and place them clearly in the composition.

faults.what: Symmetrical, stiff A-pose: both arms hang out at equal angles with legs apart and no clear line of action (125.79-125.89).
faults.fix: Offset the arms and tilt the shoulders and hips to give one clear line.

faults.what: A flat, unshaded blue square crosses the frame: it starts above the head at 126.19-126.23, then sits over his head and back at 126.26-126.29 and falls past his side at 126.33-126.36. It covers part of the silhouette and looks like a UI sticker, not confetti.
faults.fix: Shade the confetti, or remove or shrink the big blue cube. Keep it from crossing the dancer's body.

faults.what: At 126.13-126.19 his reaching hand overlaps the topiary, and the arm reads as touching or going through it.
faults.fix: Shift the reach so the hand stays clear of the topiary, or offset the dancer.
